_about: Hand-picked reference promos for 8 episodes, chosen by reading the scripts BEFORE looking at the tool's LLM output. One editor's taste, not ground truth: used to measure agreement, not correctness. Times in seconds from episode start; hook = moment that must land in the first 3 s.

promos.note: 'You are dead to the Ashcroft family' -> stepmother hurls mother's ledger into the mud -> 'Perhaps that is where it belongs.'
Ledger flung into puddle -> stranger kneels in the mud for her -> 'A noblewoman reduced to a beggar's wife!' -> 'Choose your next words carefully.'
'I want to see you crawl, sister' -> bare hands into frozen thorns or husband hangs -> 'Tell me where the garden is.'
'You are under arrest for theft' -> 'You planted it!' -> 'I want to see you crawl, sister.'
'That garden has swallowed better women than you' -> crawls through thorns, bloody hands, husband in chains screaming her name
'Then let her suffer.' -> riding-crop strike -> 'not a woman whose opinion matters' -> 'Do you want the same punishment?'
Dying duchess recognises the ring: 'My lost son wore that ring!' -> 'What is your husband's name?' -> doors burst open
'An antidote to what?' 'Poison.' -> twisted into a confession -> 'Take her.' dragged away
Chained heroine at villain's wedding: 'You needed an entire chapel to feel powerful over one chained woman?' -> cathedral doors explode -> figures in smoke
'Before I become Duchess, I want everyone to see what happens to a woman who defies this family' -> heroine paraded in prison dress
Scarred husband walks through the smoke in ducal regalia -> guards refuse to arrest him -> 'Alexander died!' 'And yet, here I stand.'
'...my lawful wife and the Duchess!' -> doors slam, priest: 'You are not his lawful wife.' -> villain smirks
'You poisoned my mother. You tortured my wife.' -> 'Wife?!' -> proclaimed Duchess -> 'Juliana?!'
